entries.en: I'll give it to Qui'in.
He is a major investor in Binary Helix corporation, which is one of Noveria's backers.
This discussion is at an end. Good day.
I have no time to entertain spaceborn vagabonds.
With any transient population. Unreliable consumer bases. Tax-dodgers, probably.
I had no idea we were so troubling to your bottom line.
I have no time to entertain colonial rubes.
No appreciation for economics. Protectionists and communists, all of them.
I have no time to entertain refugees from that urban blight called Earth.
Believe me, that is foremost in my mind.
Only a fool enters negotiation without knowledge of the other party's tendencies.
You better show some respect.
My homeworld is clean. Poverty is non-existent. If you take some perverse pride in that overheated, acid-washed slum, that is your business.
You have a problem with spacers?
You have a problem with colonials?
I'm here as a Spectre, not a human. Keep that in mind.
I see you looked up my service record.
Funny thing about humans. We're pretty loyal to our homeworld.
I won't take up much of your time.
"Vagabonds?"
"Rubes?"
You've read my file.
Watch your mouth.
I'll be brief.
Forget him, Commander. If he won't play ball, I'm sure someone else here will.
Forget him, Commander. If he won't help us, I'm sure someone else here will.
Let him be stubborn, Shepard. I'm sure someone else here is willing to help us.
Shepard. I am sure that there are other people here who could help us.
I have the package Opold wanted me to smuggle.
Here's Opold's package.
We have no business left between us.
Why not fly off and damage someone else's world?
Thank you for your assistance, Mr. Anoleis.
It's a shame you didn't cooperate in the first place.
Mr. Anoleis, all I care about is finding Benezia. Is that something you can help me with?
I don't want to upset you by showing you this evidence. Mr. Anoleis. It's fairly incriminating.
I'm not here to arrest you.
I'll hold onto it.
Oh, you're guilty.
That would be dishonest.
What do you propose?
I've earned a reward.
You owe me.
Mother of-- Corporal, secure the area. Keep everyone out of here. Now!
What happened here, Commander Shepard?
Where were you when this occurred? What did you see?
Well, not everyone responds to fear rationally. I didn't think Anoleis-sama was this tightly wound.
So you just heard it.
Still, I have to wonder why you didn't try to intervene.
That would make sense if this were a "crime of passion," something done without thinking.
He panicked. Called her in. Shot wildly. Yes. Makes sense. He was always paranoid.
Excuse me, Commander. The death of an executive must always be filed in triplicate.
So you didn't actually witness anything.
Gianna was investigating Anoleis' corruption. She worked for the Executive Board.
Beats me. I just got here myself.
I told Anoleis that Gianna was Internal Affairs. I thought it would pressure him into helping me.
I was out by Gianna's desk. I didn't see any of it.
There wasn't enough time.
I only heard an argument and shots fired.
Gianna was Internal Affairs.
[Lie] I don't know.
I told Anoleis about Gianna.
I was outside.
I heard yelling.
It happened too fast.
And I should not be telling you how to do your job. My apologies.
My job isn't arresting criminals. It's shooting terrorists.
Not my job.
Anoleis asked Gianna to see him in his office. Then there were gunshots.
Anoleis called Gianna in.
By the time I got in the door, it was already over.
If I could have, I would.
Mr. Anoleis isn’t the only one with a pass to leave Hanshan.
How may this one assist?
What if Inamorda saw this one speaking to you?
Do you have the package? The customer grows restless.
Greetings, Spectre. Have you brought the package?
The Spectre has done a great service for this one. From the deepness of light, it thanks you.
This one promised compensation for services rendered. It humbly suggests that a sum of 250 credits would be most appropriate.
Then this business is concluded. Is there anything else the other should like?
The other's words possess the discomforting ring of truth.
This one could raise the sum to 500 credits. That is half this one's profit taken by the other. It can offer no more.
This one is glad to have come to an agreement.
N-- No! This one would never--!
This one implores the Spectre for haste. The customer is quick-tempered.
You cannot do that! Inamorda will be furious with this one!
This one wants the other to leave now.
Has the other reconsidered this one's plea for aid?
This one awaits your return.
This one offers greetings. You are the Spectre that visits Port Hanshan?
Indeed, esteemed Spectre. Your arrival was not greeted with any joy by the companies here.
This one has a burden that you could ease. If an arrangement could be made, it would compensate you.
This one has procured a special item for a customer. The item is not permitted within the station. But you could bring it through customs.
That is not inaccurate.
This one humbly thanks the Spectre. The package will be delivered to your vessel. All you need do is bring it to this one.
Please do not mention this to Administrator Anoleis. That one would levy "fees."
This one's customer prefers to remain anonymous.
Your words are not unreasonable.
You understand this one's urgency? That other grows restless from the delay.
This one is humbly grateful that the Spectre understands.
This one understands. The offer shall remain open. It truly needs the help.
This one humbly begs the other to consider its request.
Of course. This one apologizes for inconveniencing you.
Show me what you're selling.
It slipped my mind. I'll get to it.
That sounds reasonable.
Would you have had any chance of getting this past customs without me? You can be a bit more generous.
That's thoughtful of you.
It'll have to do.
You're trying to make me laugh. You think I'm here to amuse you. To make funny sputtering noises when you offer an insult instead of a reward.
I've been busy. I'll pick it up later.
I haven't picked it up yet.
I'll be back later, then.
Change of plans. I've decided to keep it myself.
All right, I'll help.
I'm just browsing right now.
News travels fast here.
You want me to use my status to smuggle for you.
I have no problem with that.
I want to know where this "package" is going.
I'd be stupid to do this without knowing that I'm not equipping my own enemies.
Your customer would prefer to have his package. Tell me who it's for, or I walk out.
Deniability. He's not stupid, then. Good.
I'm supposed to uphold the law, not break it.
Could I buy something now?
Maybe later. Right now, I need supplies.
I'll think about it and get back to you.
Sure, whatever. This is a store, right?
This one would prefer no further interaction.
Yes. Does the other wish to make a purchase?
The other did what? The Spectre has betrayed this one?
The one called Anoleis will send guards here. Does the other understand? It will be very difficult for this one to make its living here.
You have no moral high ground to stand upon. You also participated in a crime.
This one wishes the other to leave now.
The Spectre has cost this one much. Perhaps more than you know. This one's livelihood depends on that income.
This one needs you to buy something.
Upset because I sold the package myself?
I sold the package to Inamorda.
I find it hard to sympathize with a smuggler.
You were breaking the law. If a real police officer had caught you, you'd be in jail for years.
Anoleis has the package. He offered a better deal.
Deal.
You needed me.
I hope that's a joke.
Good enough.
You were breaking the law.
Be glad I'm not a real cop.
You heard already?
I'm here to shop.
Smuggling, in other words.
